messages:
Priya: Heads-up: AcmeCorp asked for tenant-level model pinning + hosted fallback. They need a pilot end of next month. We need to lock scope and launch checks today. @Ethan @Marcel

Ethan: Quick tradeoff callout — full per-tenant pinning (P1) = more routing state + cache fragmentation. Alternative: templated pin API + server-side default routing (lower op cost). Recommend MVP templated pin exposed via tenant API.

Marcel: If we allow per-tenant pins we must provision pinned pools / quota enforcement. Autoscaler must avoid draining capacity from pinned pools. Ops impact non-trivial.

Lina: Customer asks: 10% canary -> evaluate -> 50% ramp. Rollback manual <=10m, auto fallback on 5xx spike. We need cost signoff; they expect <15% token cost overhead.

Alex: I'll own runbook + console UX copy. Need concrete acceptance criteria and failure modes to write rollback runbook and team comms.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Quality: nLL and hallucination rate within 5% of tenant baseline
- Latency: p95 pinned path <= baseline + 50ms
- Cost: per-token delta < 15% unless customer accepts higher
- Rollback: manual revert < 10 minutes; automatic fallback on 5xx or error rate > 3x baseline in 5m
- Observability: per-tenant metrics, pinned/fallback split, alerting
```

Ethan: Experiment plan: Stage A (10% canary, 48h), Stage B (50% ramp gated). Need power calc — for rare hallucinations we need ~2000 prompts. I'll post numbers.

Marcel: Operational rollback triggers:
- error-rate > 1% OR p95 latency breach OR sustained GPU mem > 80% for 10m.
Also add dampening (30m cool-off) to avoid oscillation.

Lina: Product prioritization: Acme pilot = P0. GA for general tenants = P2 next quarter. MVP scope: tenant-level API pin + Console toggle + minimal observability. Defer pool-level admin UI until later.

Ethan: Implementation notes:
```
API: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/pin { "model": "redwood/gpt-2-quant", "expires_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z" }
Runtime: route pinned requests; if unavailable, route to configured fallback variant.
```
KV cache compatibility and warmup are open items.

Marcel: Ops checklist:
- pre-deploy capacity run for pinned pool
- create canary dashboard and alerts
- lambda to auto-flip tenant to fallback on thresholds

Alex: Who builds evaluation sets? Need Acme prompt set + safety/regression suite. Suggest Research/Applied ML owns harness; Eng provides datasets.

Priya: Owners: Ethan=eng & experiment; Marcel=ops; Alex=docs/runbook; Lina=customer signoff. I'll create PRD skeleton and assign tasks; decision meeting Friday 10am.

Ethan: OK, will deliver power calc by EOD.

Marcel: OK, will prepare capacity test.

Lina: I'll confirm cost acceptance with Acme.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch=tenant-pinning-mvp, owner=Ethan, ci=passed, eta=2024-11-08T12:00:00Z :rocket:

Priya: If no objections I'll create the PRD and tag owners. :thumbsup:
